classifications.rationale: The President presently prohibits permission for covered aircraft operations involving Libya; the legal consequence occurs when the order takes effect, subject to later exceptions.
classifications.evidence: the granting of permission to any aircraft to take off from, land in, or overfly the United States, if the aircraft, as part of the same flight or as a continuation of that flight, is destined to land in or has taken off from the territory of Libya, is hereby prohibited

classifications.rationale: Affected executive agencies are mandatorily directed to implement the prohibition through necessary later measures, expressly including legally consequential suspension or termination of existing licenses or authorizations.
classifications.evidence: including the suspension or termination of licenses or other authorizations in effect as of the date of this order
